utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all. Thursday 08 January, quick stand-up and let's keep it moving if we can. Everyone alright?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, awake-ish. Bit rough after the football last night, to be honest.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Oh don't start, that second half was awful.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I turned it off. Better for blood pressure.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair. Also, whose new car's in the car park then? Flash little thing near the gate.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not mine, sadly.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Thought it was agency at first, but no idea.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, anyway. Updates first. David?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the Injection Moulding Line 3 yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's off the list.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Only blocker my side, can't get to the dryer until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's still tight today. We've got orders stacked up till lunch at least.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, noted, but that's not for now then. Anything else, David?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One thing to ignore, we were going to replace the belt on the chiller on three but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, cancelled then, not today's problem. Aisha?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Morning. I tested the line 1 mould temp yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On the safety side, the near miss at the wrapper still needs writing up. I'll write up the near miss at the wrapper; that's holding production up so it needs doing first, and I'll get that done by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, Aisha. Make that first priority then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll pick that up straight after this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else from process?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, one awkward one. The permit to work and isolation for the Forklift Fleet needs sorting. That one's safety critical, straight away, and it needs to be in place by next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can you take that, Aisha?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can help with the wording but I really shouldn't own it. It's more production ops and traffic management than process, if I'm honest.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's probably me, isn't it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, are you happy to sort the permit to work and isolation for the Forklift Fleet? That one's safety critical, straight away, and we need it by next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, alright. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Forklift Fleet. I'll get on that straight away and have it sorted for next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Keep me posted if you need support from HSE.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: While you're on, Callum, your general update?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Signed off the inspection on the line 2 on Tuesday, so that's done already.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, blocked, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Also, I'll send the shift handover report round. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, so I'll send the shift handover report round by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Cal. Please just make sure it actually lands with nights as well this time.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning. Nothing major from electrical. I can pick up the outfeed conveyor though — I'll grease and check the bearings on the outfeed conveyor. It needs doing this week, and I'll get that done by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good shout.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And before anyone asks, no, I won't be doing it while listening to match highlights.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You absolutely will.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya, separate one for you: can you sort the training records for the new starters? No rush, but it does need tidying up.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, Priya can do that. I'll sort the training records for the new starters. No rush, I'll work through it around the other bits.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Not much to report. I heard a slight rattle from the cooling tower, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I heard a slight rattle from the line 1 TCU, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, just observations for now then, no fresh jobs off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah exactly, just keeping an ear on both.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Morning. Stores is alright. Deliveries mostly turned up, one late courier as usual.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can I get you to check the guarding on the palletizer? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. I'll check the guarding on the palletizer.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Anything else you're taking?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: If you've got a spare minute job, I'll swap the filter on the cooling tower while I'm over that side.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Makes sense. Might help with that little noise, though I'm not saying it's the cause.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly, not chasing the rattle, just housekeeping. I'll swap the filter on the cooling tower if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine by me. Low priority, just fit it in if the morning settles down.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: On the dryer window, Sarah, if production can give me even half an hour this afternoon I'd rather use that than lose another day.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can maybe give you something after three, depends how line 4 behaves.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Take that offline after this, please. I don't want to turn the stand-up into a scheduling meeting.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On the wrapper near miss, I might need the operator statements again, Cal.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah I've got them. I'll forward them over after this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That'll help get it closed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: For the training records, are we just talking the new starters from this week, or the December lot as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: December lot as well. No rush, like I said, but it'd be good to get the training records for the new starters into one clean pack.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, got it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Palletizer guarding, just visual check or do you want me to compare against the last inspection sheet?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Compare against the last sheet if you can. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Alright, I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: If Jamie's on the cooling tower side anyway, I can just wander past later and listen again. Not a task, just a sanity check.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's fine, but yeah, not creating extra work from a maybe-noise.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Wish we treated all rattles like that. Some of ours only get noticed once they've exploded.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's because you lot call every noise 'a characteristic' till it snaps.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Unfair. Sometimes we say 'monitor it' first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Very scientific.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, comedians, focus. Let me just read back the live items.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha will write up the near miss at the wrapper; that's holding production up so it needs doing first, and that's by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum will sort the permit to work and isolation for the Forklift Fleet; that one's safety critical, straight away, due next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Cal, you'll send the shift handover report round by tomorrow. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya will sort the training records for the new starters, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And PR will grease and check the bearings on the outfeed conveyor; needs doing this week, by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, I'll get that done by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie will check the guarding on the palletizer; not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Jamie Brennan will swap the filter on the cooling tower, if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, if the morning calms down I'll do it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect. Anything genuinely urgent we've missed?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, that's it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine here.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, all set.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good to go.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, crack on then. Thanks everyone.
